controls.title: AI system inventory
controls.objective: Maintain a current inventory of AI systems, models, agents, tools, owners, purposes, data categories, users, jurisdictions and lifecycle state.
evidence_expectations: Named system owner and business purpose

controls.title: Legal applicability assessment
controls.objective: Assess each system and processing activity against relevant laws using documented entity, role, user, data, purpose, threshold and geography facts, with counsel review.

controls.title: Regulatory change monitoring
controls.objective: Monitor authoritative legislative, regulatory and court sources; record changes, effective dates, uncertainty and assigned review actions.

controls.title: Personal data inventory and purpose limitation
controls.objective: Document personal-data categories, sources, purposes, recipients, retention, controller/processor roles and lawful processing conditions.

controls.title: Consumer rights request workflow
controls.objective: Provide a governed intake, identity-check, routing, response, appeal and deletion/correction workflow for applicable privacy rights.

controls.title: Sensitive-data and high-risk processing assessment
controls.objective: Identify sensitive data and high-risk processing, document necessity and proportionality, obtain required consent and complete applicable impact assessments.

controls.title: AI risk classification and human oversight
controls.objective: Classify system risk and impact, define human review authority, escalation, override, monitoring and safe suspension criteria.
controls.owner_role: AI system owner and safety reviewer (unassigned)

controls.title: AI transparency and user notice
controls.objective: Provide clear, accessible disclosures about AI interaction and consequential automated decision support where required by the use case and law.

controls.title: Developer/deployer documentation and retention
controls.objective: Preserve intended-use, data-category, limitations, human-review and material-change documentation; apply statutory retention periods only after applicability review.
controls.owner_role: AI product owner and records owner (unassigned)

controls.title: Conversational AI user and minor safeguards
controls.objective: For covered public conversational AI services, design age estimation, AI disclosure, minor protections, privacy controls and self-harm response protocols as legally required.
evidence_expectations: Self-harm response protocol and annual report evidence

controls.title: Evidence integrity and provenance
controls.objective: Record source, collection time, integrity digest, access classification, retention and reviewer for each compliance artifact.
